items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Ziggy Elman was with it, Helen Ward, Gene Krupa was in the band

ctx.x: So why did you decide to leave finally?

Well, let's see, what happened? I think I just got tired of the road and Louie Armstrong and Bennie Goodman, John Hammond got together a battle of swing between Louie Armstrong and Benny Goodman and it was back then in the big bands, Ziggy Elman was with it, Helen Ward, Gene Krupa was in the band, Teddy Wilson playing piano, Israel Crosby on bass, Lou McGarity trombone, and so we did about 12 concerts, Battle of Swing between Louie and Benny Goodman. So a lot of the easy jumps we were

traveling by bus and a lot of times by air. Well everybody in the two bands knew each other, you know, so we had a couple of buses, Benny had his bus, Louie had his bus and sometimes we'd all ride, everybody would be up in Benny's bus, sometime almost all of Benny's band would be back there riding with Louie's bunch, talking. So one trip we had a long flight by plane, and Gene Krupa and I sat together and we were just talking, and both Gene and I were saying, 'Oh, Cozy, doggone it, I'm getting a little too old to…
